title: EasyCommands
description: Bored trying to find that one mod that has a specific command in it? Well you don't have to look now! You can create your own custom commands with full customizability!
body:
# EasyCommands

**Have you ever been stuck searching for that one plugin that has the custom command that you need? Well, let us solve that issue for you!
EasyCommands is an easy / simple way to create custom commands to your liking that can be customized to do whatever you want! Want to make a command that assigns a player a rank? Done in 5 steps! Easiest way to ever make your own commands...**

## - RELEASE 
_(Version 1.0 - Release)_
### - Consists of:
- 4 Console commands that can be played once the command is executed
- Conditions with the ability to check every argument of the custom command
- Customizable Permission, Description and unlimited slots for unique arguments!
- Unlimited custom command slots
